verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a hosted flow: the server returns a client_secret and the client calls collectFinancialConnectionsAccounts to launch authentication. The flow itself handles bank search across 12,000+ institutions, so no custom bank-collection form is needed, and an account-linked webhook fires per connected account. A beta integrator on HN corroborates using it in production. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the session-creation endpoint and of the account ID/token returned to the client after linking.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let a user connect their bank with a drop-in hosted flow — create a session server-side, open the widget, and get back a token for the connected account — without building institution UI myself

citations.quote: Use collectFinancialConnectionsAccounts to launch the authentication flow from your client using the client_secret returned by your server
Users select their bank from frequently chosen institutions or by searching more than 12,000 supported banks.
Save development time by eliminating the need to create a custom bank account collection form
Sent when a customer links a new account. If they link multiple accounts, it emits multiple events (one per account).
